title: Weights Welcome Runway: Convert, QA, and Profile Emit
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: End-to-end onboarding pipeline that accepts community model weights, validates provenance and binary integrity, converts to Redwood canonical runtime artifact, runs deterministic smoke and profiling suites, and emits a signed performance profile plus a recommended version pin and quantization profile for serving.
acceptance_criteria: Upload -> intake manifest accepted with sha256 and signature verification
Conversion produces a canonical .rwdm artifact and upload is staged to model-artifacts bucket
Deterministic smoke tests (forward pass + sampling) pass on x86 and GPU variants
Profiling pipeline publishes p50/p95 token latency, memory peak, throughput at batch sizes 1/8/32
Pin recommendation generated (semver-style) with suggested quantization profile and fallback variant
Performance profile published to model catalog and visible in Console under 'Open Models' with telemetry links
Canary rollout plan created and automated rollback policy attached
plan: Phase 1: Intake validation - manifest schema, signature check, provenance fields (author, license), and storage quarantine
Phase 2: Deterministic conversion - convert checkpoints to .rwdm format using conversion runner v2, capture conversion logs and checksums
Phase 3: Smoke & correctness - run unit sample prompts, token-level parity checks where possible, and basic safety filters
Phase 4: Profiling - run representative prompts across sequence lengths 64/512/2048 to collect latency, memory, and KV cache behavior
Phase 5: Pin recommendation - run heuristic that suggests pinned version name, quantization profile, and compatible runtime kernels
Phase 6: Publish - write profile to catalog, create canonical pin, generate release notes and Console entry, and schedule canary

blockers: License scanner false negatives: need update to include SPDX heuristics
KMS integration for manifest signing is pending customer key policy review
Conversion runner OOM for >30B models on current staging nodes - hardware validation required
notes_and_tradeoffs: We intentionally decouple conversion from profiling to allow parallel retries without re-ingesting weights
Tradeoff: Conservative pin recommendation may lead to more fallback variants (higher surface area) but reduces customer-facing regressions
We will avoid lossy quantization during initial publish; quantization recommendations will be advisory until a manual gate approves aggressive profiles
